Next, we subtract from both sides

Then, we multiply both sides by

This gives us the linear system form of Newton’s method. This equivalent form allows us to solve directly for the update direction without ever computing the inverse of the Jacobian.

?

Suppose we want to solve a system of nonlinear equations
